senses.definition: (intransitive, informal) To emit digestive gases from the anus; to flatulate.

quotes.text: I fart with twenty ladies by; / They call me beast; and what care I?
quotes.reference: 1728, Jonathan Swift, A Dialogue between Mad Mullinix and Timothy:

senses.definition: (transitive, figuratively, informal) To emit (fumes, gases, etc.).

quotes.text: Above his head the funnel farted black soot into the sky.
quotes.reference: 1988, Peter Carey, chapter 95, in Oscar and Lucinda, London: Faber and Faber, published 1989, page 457:

quotes.text: We’ve been stuck behind a Ford Escort farting black smoke for ten minutes.
quotes.reference: 2014, Marlon James, A Brief History of Seven Killings, New York: Riverhead Books, page 139:

senses.definition: (informal) An emission of digestive gases from the anus; a flatus.
examples: I think I heard a fart. Was it you, Nigella?
Silent farts are often the smelliest.

quotes.text: Metrocles somewhat indiscreetly, as he was disputing in his Schole, in presence of his auditory, let a fart, for shame whereof he afterwards kept his house and could not be drawen abroad[…].
quotes.reference: 1603, Michel de Montaigne, chapter 12, in John Florio, transl., The Essayes […], book II, London: […] Val[entine] Simmes for Edward Blount […], →OCLC:
